question: Who was the first Indian woman wrestler to represent the country at the 2012 London Olympic Games?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Geeta Phogat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Geeta Phogat is the first Indian woman wrestler to qualify for the Olympic Games.
 
• She represented India at the 2012 London Olympics in the women's freestyle 55 kg category.
 
• Geeta Phogat is also a gold medalist at the Commonwealth Games, winning in 2010.
 
• She hails from a family of wrestlers, with her sisters Babita and Vinesh Phogat also being notable wrestlers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Olympic Games**

 
 
• The Olympic Games are a major international multi-sport event held every four years.
 
• They are divided into Summer and Winter Olympic Games, with each occurring every four years but two years apart.
 
• The modern Olympic Games were inspired by the ancient Olympic Games held in Olympia, Greece, from the 8th century BC to the 4th century AD.
 
• The International Olympic Committee (IOC) is the governing body of the Olympic Movement, with the Olympic Charter defining its structure and authority.
 
 
 
• **Commonwealth Games**
 
 
• The Commonwealth Games is an international multi-sport event involving athletes from the Commonwealth of Nations.
 
• The event was first held in 1930 and, with the exception of 1942 and 1946 (cancelled due to World War II), has taken place every four years since then.
 
• The games are overseen by the Commonwealth Games Federation (CGF), which ensures the event is held in a manner consistent with its principles of equality and inclusivity.
 
• The Commonwealth Games include a range of sports and are known for their spirit of friendly competition and camaraderie among the member countries.
 
 
 
• **Freestyle Wrestling**
 
 
• Freestyle wrestling is a style of amateur wrestling that is practiced worldwide.
 
• In freestyle wrestling, athletes can use their legs in both offense and defense and are allowed to hold their opponents above or below the waist.
 
• It is one of the two styles of wrestling contested in the Olympic Games, the other being Greco-Roman wrestling.
 
• Freestyle wrestling emphasizes both the physical and technical aspects of the sport, making it a dynamic and challenging discipline.
 
 
 
• **Phogat Family**
 
 
• The Phogat family from Haryana, India, is renowned for their achievements in wrestling.
 
• Mahavir Singh Phogat, the patriarch of the family, is a former wrestler and coach who trained his daughters in the sport.
 
• Geeta, Babita, Ritu, and Vinesh Phogat have all achieved significant success in wrestling, making the family a symbol of perseverance and excellence.
 
• Their story was popularized in the 2016 Bollywood film "Dangal," which portrayed Mahavir Phogat's efforts to train his daughters to become world-class wrestlers.
